title: Binance Hot Wallet Exploit: Aave's Response
headline: Aave contributors describe their response to a reported Binance hot wallet exploit, including freezing reserves across Aave V3 and V4 networks.
summary: A forum post, last updated 01:00 UTC on 30 October 2026, says that on 29 October a Binance hot wallet on Ethereum sent about 63 tokens and 167,464 ETH to a single address, with further inflows from a second hot wallet and on other chains. The post says one wallet in the exploiter's cluster supplied 60M USDT on Aave V3 Ethereum Core and borrowed 19,762 WETH (about $44.6M then), and that this is its only Aave position; it is described as over-collateralised and subject to normal liquidation. The post says that after a joint war room with Aave Labs, TokenLogic and Certora, guardian multisigs froze 175 reserves on Aave V3 across 16 networks and 117 on Aave V4 across four networks between 21:42 and 23:04 UTC. Users can still repay, withdraw and be liquidated, but cannot add collateral or open new positions. The Horizon RWA market was left open and no market was paused. Oracle feeds are reported to have worked normally. Details are as stated by the post's authors.
